name: Air Jordan 11 Retro GS 'Gamma Blue' 2025
story_html: Made for big kids, the 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro GS 'Gamma Blue' celebrates the 30th anniversary of the championship silhouette. The design is faithful to the original 2013 release, featuring a black ballistic mesh upper with a color-matched patent leather mudguard. A Jumpman logo in pastel blue embroidery adorns the lateral collar, while the back tab is marked with a stylized '23' outlined in Varsity Maize. The sneaker sits atop a matching black Phylon midsole, supported underfoot by a blue-tinged semi-translucent rubber outsole.
